chrome-chalcedony.colors: Dark green, translucent, with a strong red reaction to the Chelsea filter.

chromite.name: Chromite
chromite.colors: Dark gray to black, rarely brownish black.

chrysocolla-chalcedony.name: Chrysocolla Chalcedony
chrysocolla-chalcedony.colors: Blue to blue-green, opaque to near transparent.

cinnabar.name: Cinnabar
cinnabar.colors: Bright red to brownish red, sometimes gray.

clinochlore.name: Clinochlore
clinochlore.colors: Grass-green, olive-green, yellowish or white, also pink to rose-red.

clinozoisite.name: Clinozoisite
clinozoisite.colors: Colorless, pale yellow, pink, red, gray or green. Pakistani crystals are gemmy brown.

cobaltite.name: Cobaltite
cobaltite.colors: Silver-white, opaque, with a grayish black streak.

colemanite.name: Colemanite
colemanite.colors: Colorless, milky white, pale yellow or gray.

color-change-garnet.name: Color Change Garnet
color-change-garnet.colors: Blue-green in daylight and purple in incandescent light for the Madagascar stones. Other stones shift red to purplish red.

color-change-sapphire.name: Color Change Sapphire
color-change-sapphire.colors: Blue to violet in daylight-equivalent light, purplish pink to pinkish purple in incandescent light.

columbite.name: Columbite
columbite.colors: Dark black, iron black to dark brown.

conch-shell.name: Conch Shell
conch-shell.colors: A fashioned Queen conch shell bead showed alternating white, cream and light pink bands.

conichalcite.name: Conichalcite
conichalcite.colors: Grass green to yellowish green, pistachio green and emerald green, zoned in places, and from dominantly green to dominantly yellow.

coquimbite.name: Coquimbite
coquimbite.colors: Pale violet to amethystine, rarely pale yellow or pale green.

cordierite.name: Cordierite
cordierite.colors: Blue, smoky blue and bluish violet, also greenish, yellowish brown or gray.

corundum.name: Corundum, the Mineral Behind Ruby & Every Sapphire Color
corundum.colors: Typically gray to brown, colorless when pure, with trace metals giving almost any color. Chromium gives red and iron with titanium give blue.

covellite.name: Covellite
covellite.colors: Indigo-blue or darker, commonly highly iridescent, brass-yellow to deep red.

creedite.name: Creedite
creedite.colors: Colorless to white and purple, with orange material from newer sources.

crocoite.name: Crocoite
crocoite.colors: Intense red-orange to yellow-orange, with hyacinth-red crystals.

cryolite.name: Cryolite
cryolite.colors: Colorless, white, pale brown, pink and smoky to black.

cummingtonite.name: Cummingtonite
cummingtonite.colors: Dark green, brown, gray or beige.

datolite.name: Datolite
datolite.colors: Colorless or white, commonly with a greenish tinge, and also grayish, yellow, green, red or pink.

demantoid-garnet.name: Demantoid Garnet
demantoid-garnet.colors: Deep forest greens to light, nearly colorless hues, with yellow secondary hues often present and brown when saturation is low.

dendritic-quartz.name: Dendritic Quartz
dendritic-quartz.colors: Transparent with reddish-brown or black dendritic inclusions.

descloizite.name: Descloizite
descloizite.colors: Brownish red, red-orange, reddish brown to blackish brown, nearly black.

desert-jasper.name: Desert Jasper
desert-jasper.colors: Earthy red, brown, yellow, gray and cream.

diaspore.name: Diaspore
diaspore.colors: White, pale gray, colorless, greenish gray, brown, pale yellow, pink or lilac, and it may change color from brownish green in daylight to raspberry pink in artificial light.

dogtooth-calcite.name: Dogtooth Calcite
dogtooth-calcite.colors: Clear colorless or amber-orange examples are considered classics.

eclogite.name: Eclogite
eclogite.colors: Red garnet in bright dark green omphacite.

ekanite.name: Ekanite
ekanite.colors: Colorless, light to dark green, yellow-green to yellowish brown, straw-yellow, red from inclusions.

enstatite.name: Enstatite
enstatite.colors: White, grayish, yellowish, greenish, olive-green or brown.

eosphorite.name: Eosphorite
eosphorite.colors: Pink to rose-red, commonly brown to black when oxidized.

erythrite.name: Erythrite
erythrite.colors: Crimson to peach-red, pale rose, or pink, may be zoned.

ethiopian-welo-opal.name: Ethiopian Welo Opal
ethiopian-welo-opal.colors: Vivid play-of-color on a clear, white, yellow, orange or brown body color.

euxenite.name: Euxenite
euxenite.colors: Black with a tinge of yellow, brown or green.

feldspar.name: Feldspar, the Mineral Family Behind Moonstone, Sunstone & Labradorite
feldspar.colors: Usually white, pink, gray or brown, also colorless, yellow, orange, red, black, blue and green.

ferberite.name: Ferberite
ferberite.colors: Black, dark brown in transmitted light.

fire-opal.name: Fire Opal
fire-opal.colors: Orange, yellow, red, brown or a combination; Mexico is best known for bright yellow, orange and red fire opal.
fire-opal.chakra: Yellow fire opal is tied to the solar plexus chakra (S5).
fire-opal.birthstone: Fire opal is described as an April birthstone and an alternative to opal for October (S5); opal in general is an October birthstone (S1).

franklinite.name: Franklinite
franklinite.colors: Iron-black, brown or red, may be tarnished.

gabbro.name: Gabbro
gabbro.colors: Usually black or dark green, sometimes with a few light-colored grains.

gaspeite.name: Gaspeite
gaspeite.colors: Yellowish green to bright green, often with brown matrix or mottling.

gem-silica.name: Gem Silica
gem-silica.colors: Bluish green to greenish blue, with the best stones a strongly saturated blue.

gibbsite.name: Gibbsite
gibbsite.colors: Colorless, white, gray, pale green or pale red.

glauberite.name: Glauberite
glauberite.colors: Gray or pale yellow, also colorless.

gray-diamond.name: Gray Diamond
gray-diamond.colors: Pure gray, or gray with blue, purple, violet, yellow or green tones.

green-apatite.name: Green Apatite
green-apatite.colors: Green, from light green stones called asparagus stones to golden green. Green apatites fluoresce a greenish mustard color.

green-apophyllite.name: Green Apophyllite
green-apophyllite.colors: Pastel green, as shown by specimens from Poona, India.

green-diamond.name: Green Diamond
green-diamond.colors: Green, often with a secondary blue or yellow tone, or a grayish or brownish green.

green-kyanite.name: Green Kyanite
green-kyanite.colors: Green. Green kyanite occurs as blades in quartzite.

green-malachite.name: Green Malachite
green-malachite.colors: Banded light and dark green, or just dark green when crystalline.

green-zircon.name: Green Zircon
green-zircon.birthstone: Zircon in general is a December birthstone.

greenockite.name: Greenockite
greenockite.colors: Shades of yellow and orange, rarely deep red.

gypsum.name: Gypsum, the Mineral Behind Selenite, Satin Spar & Desert Rose
gypsum.colors: Clear, colorless, white, gray, yellow, red and brown.

gyrolite.name: Gyrolite
gyrolite.colors: Colorless to white, sometimes grayish, tan, yellowish, brownish or pale green from inclusions.

hambergite.name: Hambergite
hambergite.colors: Colorless, pale gray and pale yellow.

hanksite.name: Hanksite
hanksite.colors: Colorless to pale yellow, may be grayish green due to clay inclusions.

hauyne.name: Hauyne
hauyne.colors: Celebrated in blue, but also white, gray, green, yellow, red and pink.

hawks-eye.name: Hawks Eye
hawks-eye.colors: Blue, the original crocidolite color left unstained.

hedenbergite.name: Hedenbergite
hedenbergite.colors: Black, dark green or green-brown, brownish green in thin section.

herderite.name: Herderite
herderite.colors: Light green, colorless in transmitted light. Brazilian crystals also come colorless, pink, green and violetish.

heulandite.name: Heulandite
heulandite.colors: Colorless, white, gray, yellow, red, pink, orange, brown or black.

hexagonite.name: Hexagonite
hexagonite.colors: Pinkish purple, with pink, orangy pink and violet pleochroic colors.

hollandite.name: Hollandite
hollandite.colors: Black, grayish black to silvery gray.

holly-blue-agate.name: Holly Blue Agate
holly-blue-agate.colors: Blue modified by slight to moderate pink, giving a noticeably lavender gem.

hornblende.name: Hornblende
hornblende.colors: Usually black, dark green or dark brown.

humite.name: Humite
humite.colors: White, yellow, dark orange or brown.

hydrogrossular-garnet.name: Hydrogrossular Garnet
hydrogrossular-garnet.colors: Most often bluish green, also pink, white and gray.

indonesian-blue-amber.name: Indonesian Blue Amber
indonesian-blue-amber.colors: Greenish blue, a surface fluorescence stimulated by ultraviolet light.

inesite.name: Inesite
inesite.colors: Rose-red, pink, orange-pink, orange-red-brown and deep wine-red, turning ginger-brown on exposure.

jamesonite.name: Jamesonite
jamesonite.colors: Gray-black, and it may tarnish iridescent.

jaspillite.name: Jaspillite
jaspillite.colors: Gray hematite bands alternating with red jasper bands.

jeremejevite.name: Jeremejevite
jeremejevite.colors: Colorless, light blue, yellow-brown, greenish, light or golden yellow, and sometimes violet.

k2-jasper.name: K2 Jasper
k2-jasper.colors: Bright white granite with sharply contrasting bright blue azurite orbs, sometimes green malachite stains.

kernite.name: Kernite
kernite.colors: Colorless, white if altered at the surface to tincalconite.

kornerupine.name: Kornerupine
kornerupine.colors: Colorless, white, blue, green, dark green, greenish yellow, yellow-brown and black. Gem material is mostly dark brown or green, with lighter green from Kenya.

lawsonite.name: Lawsonite
lawsonite.colors: Colorless, white, pale blue to grayish blue, translucent.

lazulite.name: Lazulite
lazulite.colors: Azure blue, sky blue, bluish white, yellow green or blue green, rarely green.

leucite.name: Leucite
leucite.colors: White and gray, colorless in thin section.

libethenite.name: Libethenite
libethenite.colors: Light to dark olive-green, dark green, blackish green and black.

limonite.name: Limonite
limonite.colors: Yellowish brown to brown to black.

ludlamite.name: Ludlamite
ludlamite.colors: Apple green to bright green, nearly colorless in transmitted light.

mali-garnet.name: Mali Garnet
mali-garnet.colors: Mostly yellow-green to brown, rarely intense green. Golden and olive-green stones are shown, and some rare ones change from grayish green to brown.

mandarin-garnet.name: Mandarin Garnet
mandarin-garnet.colors: Vivid orange, the classic mandarin orange hue.

maw-sit-sit.name: Maw Sit Sit
maw-sit-sit.colors: Highly saturated green to light green and even black, often mottled or veined with black and sometimes white.

mellite.name: Mellite
mellite.colors: Honey-yellow, deep red, pale shades of red, brown, gray and white.

microcline.name: Microcline
microcline.colors: White, pale cream-yellow, red, green and blue, colorless in thin section.

microlite.name: Microlite
microlite.colors: Green and brown crystals, golden orange crystals, garnet red crystals, and massive brownish or reddish material.

millerite.name: Millerite
millerite.colors: Pale brass-yellow to bronze-yellow, tarnishing to iridescence.

mimetite.name: Mimetite
mimetite.colors: Pale to bright yellow, yellowish brown, yellow-orange or white, may be colorless.

mordenite.name: Mordenite
mordenite.colors: Colorless, white, yellowish and pinkish, with color in cut material due to staining.

moroccan-agate.name: Moroccan Agate
moroccan-agate.colors: Pink-orange outer rim and red-brown inner rim, with a mostly gray-blue or white interior (Sidi Rahal agate).

mottramite.name: Mottramite
mottramite.colors: Grass green, olive green, yellow green, siskin green, blackish brown to nearly black.

muscovite.name: Muscovite
muscovite.colors: Colorless in thin sheets, sometimes tinted brown, yellow, green or rose. Thick pieces look black, brown or silver.

neon-apatite.name: Neon Apatite
neon-apatite.colors: Neon green, mint green, blue-green and blue, including a Paraiba-like blue and an indicolite-like blue.

nepheline.name: Nepheline
nepheline.colors: Colorless, white, gray or yellowish, and variously colored by impurities.

neptunite.name: Neptunite
neptunite.colors: Black, deep red-brown in thin fragments, nearly opaque.

nontronite.name: Nontronite
nontronite.colors: Yellow, olive-green, green, orange and brown, and may be zoned.

okenite.name: Okenite
okenite.colors: White or colorless, sometimes slightly yellow.

oligoclase.name: Oligoclase
oligoclase.colors: White, sometimes tinted gray, green or red.

orange-aventurine.name: Orange Aventurine
orange-aventurine.colors: Orange, including reddish-orange pieces. Colors other than green are uncommon in aventurine.

orange-diamond.name: Orange Diamond
orange-diamond.colors: Orangey-red to yellowish-orange, with pure orange being very rare.

oregon-sunstone.name: Oregon Sunstone
oregon-sunstone.colors: Clear, gold, peach, coral, pink, red, green and blue.

orpiment.name: Orpiment
orpiment.colors: Lemon-yellow to golden or brownish yellow, also bright orange or lustrous brown.

owyhee-blue-opal.name: Owyhee Blue Opal
owyhee-blue-opal.colors: Blue gray to brilliant sky blue, including pale to medium blue and powder blue.

padparadscha-sapphire.name: Padparadscha Sapphire
padparadscha-sapphire.colors: A subtle mix of pinkish orange to orangey pink with pastel tones and low to medium saturation, per the LMHC definition.

painite.name: Painite
painite.colors: Deep garnet red to brownish red-orange.

paragonite.name: Paragonite
paragonite.colors: Colorless, pale yellow, grayish, grayish white, greenish, light apple-green.

pargasite.name: Pargasite
pargasite.colors: Bluish green, grayish black, light brown, bright green when chromium bearing.

peach-quartz.name: Peach Quartz
peach-quartz.colors: Light orange to bright orange to brownish orange.

peanut-obsidian.name: Peanut Obsidian
peanut-obsidian.colors: Gray to greenish gray base with red or brownish red stellate spherulites.

peanut-wood.name: Peanut Wood
peanut-wood.colors: Dark brown to black wood with white to cream oval markings.

peristerite.name: Peristerite
peristerite.colors: Iridescence that is either blue or white (white or bluish schiller).

perthite.name: Perthite
perthite.colors: Nearly colorless, white, flesh to salmon-pink, shades of green, gray or brown.

petalite.name: Petalite
petalite.colors: Colorless, white, gray, rarely reddish or greenish.

phosphophyllite.name: Phosphophyllite
phosphophyllite.colors: Pale bluish green, sea-green or colorless.

pink-aventurine.name: Pink Aventurine
pink-aventurine.colors: Pink, with the sparkly glitter of aventurescence.

pink-diamond.name: Pink Diamond
pink-diamond.colors: Pink, sometimes with brown, orange, yellow or purple secondary hues.

pipestone.name: Pipestone
pipestone.colors: Red, from traces of hematite, described as deep reddish brown for catlinite.

plumbogummite.name: Plumbogummite
plumbogummite.colors: Grayish white, grayish blue, yellowish gray, yellowish brown, green or pale blue.

plume-agate.name: Plume Agate
plume-agate.colors: Virtually colorless or light colored, commonly bluish, with red, yellow, yellowish brown or violet plumes.
plume-agate.chakra: Moss agate in general is said to be connected with the heart chakra.
plume-agate.birthstone: Agate in general is considered by some people the birthstone for June.

pollucite.name: Pollucite
pollucite.colors: Colorless, white or gray, or tinted pink, blue or violet.

powellite.name: Powellite
powellite.colors: Straw-yellow, greenish yellow, yellow-brown, brown, colorless, may be zoned, also blue to nearly black. Copper-rich material can be green.

proustite.name: Proustite
proustite.colors: Deep red, scarlet to vermilion, with a bright red streak. Darker, more metallic crystals still look red when backlit.

pumpellyite.name: Pumpellyite
pumpellyite.colors: Green, bluish green, greenish black, brown.

purple-chalcedony.name: Purple Chalcedony
purple-chalcedony.colors: Grayish, slightly reddish purple, in darker and lighter shades.

purple-diamond.name: Purple Diamond
purple-diamond.colors: Purple, often with gray or brown undertones, and sometimes paired with a pink hue.

pyrargyrite.name: Pyrargyrite
pyrargyrite.colors: Deep red, darkens with exposure to light.

pyrope.name: Pyrope
pyrope.colors: Dark blood red, sometimes with a very slight brownish tint.

pyrophyllite.name: Pyrophyllite
pyrophyllite.colors: White, pale blue, yellow, apple-green, grayish green or brownish green.

pyroxmangite.name: Pyroxmangite
pyroxmangite.colors: Pink to red, often with brown or black oxidation coatings, and reddish brown to purplish pink when transparent.

pyrrhotite.name: Pyrrhotite
pyrrhotite.colors: Brownish bronze, reddish bronze and yellowish bronze, usually tarnished.

quartz.name: Types of Quartz, the Mineral Behind Most Crystals
quartz.colors: Occurs in virtually every color, commonly clear, white, gray, purple, yellow, brown, black, pink, green and red.

quartzite.name: Quartzite
quartzite.colors: Usually white to gray, pink, red or purple when stained by iron, and sometimes yellow, orange, brown, green or blue.

rainbow-andradite-garnet.name: Rainbow Andradite Garnet
rainbow-andradite-garnet.colors: Dark root-beer brown with an iridescent play of color.

red-diamond.name: Red Diamond
red-diamond.colors: Red, with blended grades that include purple, brown and orange hues.

rhodizite.name: Rhodizite
rhodizite.colors: Colorless to white, with a possible pale gray or pale yellow tinge.

rhyolite.name: Rhyolite
rhyolite.colors: Light gray, pink, yellowish, cream, mauve, tan to medium brown, and light to brick-red, with mottled or banded patterns common.

rutile.name: Rutile
rutile.colors: Reddish brown, red, pale yellow, pale blue or violet, rarely grass-green, black if rich in Nb and Ta.

saltwater-pearl.name: Saltwater Pearl
saltwater-pearl.colors: White to cream, often with rose, blue or green overtones. Black, gray, yellow and gold also occur, and Tahitian cultured pearls are black or very dark with green and purplish pink overtones.

samarskite.name: Samarskite
samarskite.colors: Velvet-black, sometimes with a brownish tint, and brown to yellowish brown when altered.

sanidine.name: Sanidine
sanidine.colors: Mostly colorless, occasionally brown or yellow.

sapphirine.name: Sapphirine
sapphirine.colors: Light to dark blue or green, white, gray, pale red and yellow. Gem material is most often grayish blue, rarely violet, purple, green, pink, brown or red.

scapolite.name: Scapolite
scapolite.colors: Near colorless through pinks and purples to yellow and orange, with yellow the most common.

scorodite.name: Scorodite
scorodite.colors: Pale leek green, grayish green, liver brown, pale blue, violet, yellow, pale grayish or colorless.

sillimanite.name: Sillimanite
sillimanite.colors: Colorless or white to gray, also brown, yellow, yellow-green, gray-green, blue-green, blue.

sinhalite.name: Sinhalite
sinhalite.colors: Colorless, pale yellow, yellow, greenish brown and dark brown, or brownish pink to pale pink if chromian.

sleeping-beauty-turquoise.name: Sleeping Beauty Turquoise
sleeping-beauty-turquoise.colors: Sky blue to soft creamy blue, with virtually no matrix.
sleeping-beauty-turquoise.birthstone: Turquoise in general is the December birthstone.

smithsonite.name: Smithsonite
smithsonite.colors: Usually brown or gray, but may be colorless, white, yellow, green, blue or pink.

sonora-sunrise.name: Sonora Sunrise
sonora-sunrise.colors: Bluish-green chrysocolla beside bright red cuprite, a red sky over a green landscape.

sonora-sunset.name: Sonora Sunset
sonora-sunset.colors: Bluish-green with bright red, with some black iron minerals and orange chalcotrichite.

spectrolite.name: Spectrolite
spectrolite.colors: Flashes of dark red, orange, yellow, blue and green, with strong multicolor labradorescence.

sphene-titanite.name: Sphene Titanite
sphene-titanite.colors: Yellow, orange, brown and green, often zoned. Also colorless, red, blue and black.

spodumene.name: Spodumene
spodumene.colors: White, gray, colorless, yellow, green, blue, lilac, pink and brown, sometimes pleochroic.

sponge-coral.name: Sponge Coral
sponge-coral.colors: Strong orangey-red, often with fine yellow or orange trails, and also blue sponge coral with a grayish hue.

spurrite.name: Spurrite
spurrite.colors: White to gray or lavender-gray, and medium to dark purple in material from Mexico.

staurolite.name: Staurolite
staurolite.colors: Usually brown, reddish brown, yellowish brown, brownish black, black or dark gray.

steatite-soapstone.name: Steatite Soapstone
steatite-soapstone.colors: White, gray, greenish gray or pale green, often discolored reddish or brownish and mottled.

strontianite.name: Strontianite
strontianite.colors: Colorless, gray, pale yellow, pale green, yellowish brown or pale red.

tantalite.name: Tantalite
tantalite.colors: Dark black, iron-black to dark brown or even reddish brown.

thulite.name: Thulite
thulite.colors: Pink to reddish, sometimes mottled with streaks or spots of white quartz.

tremolite.name: Tremolite
tremolite.colors: White, gray, lavender to pink, transparent to translucent.

triplite.name: Triplite
triplite.colors: Chestnut-brown, reddish brown, flesh-red, salmon-pink, brownish black to black if altered.

uvite.name: Uvite
uvite.colors: Brown, light to dark green, red and black, and may be zoned.

vayrynenite.name: Vayrynenite
vayrynenite.colors: Rose-red, salmon-pink, pale pink, brownish pink and pale gray.

vera-cruz-amethyst.name: Vera Cruz Amethyst
vera-cruz-amethyst.colors: Very pale, clear amethyst crystals, often phantomed with a clear quartz interior.

veszelyite.name: Veszelyite
veszelyite.colors: Greenish blue to dark blue, greenish blue in transmitted light.

villiaumite.name: Villiaumite
villiaumite.colors: Carmine red, lavender pink to light orange.

wavellite.name: Wavellite
wavellite.colors: White, greenish white, green, yellow, yellowish brown, turquoise-blue, brown, brownish black.

whewellite.name: Whewellite
whewellite.colors: Colorless, white, may be pale yellow or pale brown.

wollastonite.name: Wollastonite
wollastonite.colors: White, colorless, brown, red, yellow or pale green.

xonotlite.name: Xonotlite
xonotlite.colors: Chalky white to bluish gray or pale pink, and the color fades on exposure.

yellow-diamond.name: Yellow Diamond
yellow-diamond.colors: Pure yellow, or yellow mixed with green, orange or brown, from muted brownish to vivid yellow.

yellow-fluorite.name: Yellow Fluorite
yellow-fluorite.colors: Yellow, including pale yellow, as in cut yellow fluorites listed from Illinois.

yellow-quartz.name: Yellow Quartz
yellow-quartz.colors: Pale yellow through yellow-orange to rich golden orange and very dark orange. Gem-A adds brownish orange and greenish yellow.
yellow-quartz.birthstone: Citrine is the birthstone for November.

zebra-stone.name: Zebra Stone
zebra-stone.colors: Alternating red and white or cream bands, described for zebra rock.

zincite.name: Zincite
zincite.colors: Yellow-orange to deep red, rarely yellow, green or colorless.
